notes.title: Thank you for your love and support!
notes.notes:
[img]https://i.imgur.com/xUVZlgc.gif[/img]

Announced during [b]The Game Awards[/b] ceremony, [b]Shady Part of Me [/b]has received incredible feedback. We are pleased to offer a[b] dreamlike and emotional adventure[/b] that has been greeted with overwhelming positive reviews from players and the press. 

In our Accolade Trailer, we celebrate the warm welcome that Shady Part of Me has received. 

[previewyoutube=2zqZyeHD4Og;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Featuring the haunting voice of Hannah Murray (Game of Thrones, Skins),[/b] Shady Part of Me is an [b]emotional and poetic fable with a unique artistic direction. [/b]

Throughout your adventure, alternate at any time between a little girl and her shadow in an elegant mix of 3D and 2D. T[b]he duo will have to learn to cooperate[/b] in order to progress through a dreamlike world.

[b]Shady Part of Me is available on Steam. [/b]Take advantage of a [b]10% discount on the price of the game until December 24th. [/b]

For more information, visit the[url=https://www.focus-home.com/en-us/games/shady-part-of-me] official website[/url] or join our [url=https://discord.gg/focushome]discord[/url].

notes.title: Shady Part Of Me is now available!
notes.notes:
We are delighted to announce [b]today’s release of Shady Part of Me[/b], an emotional and dream-like journey, with breathtaking artistic direction and the [b]enthralling voice of Hannah Murray (Game of Thrones, Skins). [/b]

We are extremely proud to release our first project after years of hardwork and dedication from our small team. We can’t wait for everyone to jump in and enter a world where we put a lot of ourselves in as well as our own personal journey toward self-discovery. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35537874/941c5d4a044e47640aa2c76b0790621ead3d2703.jpg[/img]

Discover the [b]Launch Trailer[/b] showcased during[b] The Game Awards 2020[/b], and overcome emotional struggles through surreal dreamscapes where a[b] little girl and her shadow must learn, cooperate, and evolve to progress in a poetic journey. [/b]

[previewyoutube=iHzwX0Nv5G4;full][/previewyoutube]
During your adventure, alternate at any time between the little girl and her shadow in an elegant[b] mix of 3D and 2D gameplay[/b]. Both must learn, cooperate and evolve to progress in a poetic journey.[b] Don’t fear failure,[/b] face any situation with the ability to [b]turn back time at any moment.[/b]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/HJaHmNQ.gif[/img]

[b]Shady Part of Me is available today on Steam.  Enjoy an exclusive 10% discount on Steam until December 24th. [/b]

For more information,[b] [url=https://www.focus-home.com/games/shady-part-of-me#shop]visit the official website.[/url] [/b]Feel free to get in touch with our team by joining our discord or reaching out to us on social media!
